title: EUN BI of MAKAMAKA - Pages of Us
description:
EUN BI of MAKAMAKA presents "Pages of Us."

This album captures the excitement of a new beginning, the emotions of farewell and a fresh start crossing paths, and the quiet determination to keep your own color through everyday life.

This video features selected previews from the album.

Track List
1. Intro : One day
2. Good Night Good Morning
3. Still Here
4. My Own Page
5. Good Night Good Morning (Inst.)

Title Track
Good Night Good Morning
A song that delicately expresses the emotional line where the feeling of farewell and the excitement of a new beginning coexist through EUN BI's powerful and refreshing vocals.

Still Here (Feat. Zip.Y)
A track that carries a message of strength, comfort, and quiet resilience, reminding us not to lose our own color even in a gray everyday life.

My Own Page (Feat. Zip.Y)
A song that captures the overwhelming feeling of facing a childhood dream and the hope of drawing the future together, with the warm message that this moment we share becomes our most precious page.

Now available on YouTube Music, Melon, Genie Music, FLO, and more streaming platforms.
